title: 2" mattress gel pad
text: 2" mattress gel pad. Purchased this for my 80 year old mom to try on top of her very expensive adjustable bed and mattress.  She had loved the 4" version on my guestroom bed.  Sad it felt like sleeping on a marshmallow and she loved it. But she didn't want the extra height of the 4" so she asked for the 2".  I really didn't think the 2" would be as good, but honestly she SWEARS by this pad.  Says its the best sleep she's had in years and years.  I cannot argue with that.  Sleep is hard to come by at 80 years old.  So, if this helps, best money I've ever spent on a mattress pad!
